POL_RETURNS: Returns Policy: Returns are allowed within 7 days of delivery for unused products with original packaging. Discounted products are returnable only if the discount is 30 percent or less.
POL_EXCHANGE: Exchange Policy: Size exchanges are allowed within 10 days of delivery, subject to stock availability. Exchange is not available for intimate wear or final sale products.
POL_SHIPPING: Shipping Policy: Standard delivery usually takes 3 to 5 business days. Express delivery usually takes 1 to 2 business days in serviceable pin codes. Orders above Rs. 1,999 qualify for free standard shipping.
POL_REFUND: Refund Policy: Refunds are processed after the returned item passes quality inspection. Prepaid refunds are generally issued within 5 to 7 business days. Cash-on-delivery orders are refunded to customer bank/UPI details after verification.
POL_WARRANTY: Warranty Policy: Watches and selected accessories carry a 6-month limited warranty against manufacturing defects. Physical damage and normal wear are excluded.
